import json,urllib.request
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/"
def get(path,method="GET"):
  req=urllib.request.Request(root+path,method=method,headers={"User-Agent":"OnTrack-V24-Public-Release-Smoke","Cache-Control":"no-cache"})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as r:
    assert r.status==200
    return json.loads(r.read(16384)) if method=="GET" else dict(r.headers)
m=json.loads(get("native/latest.json")["payload"])
assert m["version_code"]==24 and m["version_name"]=="0.3.3-ota"
assert m["sha256"]=="a300840a87c9f22039a97056b3fb60a03fd000e83ee4f1df307028dc427a0cd8"
apk=get("native/"+m["file"],"HEAD")
assert int(apk.get("Content-Length",0))==m["size"]==55016134
u=json.loads(get("latest.json")["payload"])
assert u["revision"]==20 and u["sha256"]=="d922372c57b343a9487a64015763483ea02f9d616db9d36594ef3b5207ee9300"
ui=get(u["file"],"HEAD")
assert int(ui.get("Content-Length",0))==u["size"]
print(json.dumps({"status":"public_verified","android":m["version_name"],"version_code":24,"apk_http":200,"apk_bytes":m["size"],"ota_revision":20,"ota_http":200,"html_http":200,"apk_file":m["file"]}))
